_comment: Shared statistical definitions for every renderer (spec 010 FR-004). Hand-edited; no process writes it. A deliverable prints a term's definition in parentheses on its first use and the bare term afterwards. Definitions carry no digits, so every digit in a deliverable traces to a fact read at run time (Principle VI). Wording follows county-profile.html and data/county_policy_intervals.md.

calibrated_score.definition: a measure between zero and one of how closely the county's profile resembles counties that have enacted a restriction, recalibrated so that scores match how often enactments are observed; it is a resemblance measure, not a forecast of opposition to any project

interval.definition: the range of probabilities that a separate calibration of the same model supports for a county with this profile; because the calibration is separate, the range need not contain the calibrated score, and a wide range means thin evidence

decile.definition: the county's tenth of the national score distribution, numbered from one for the lowest tenth to ten for the highest

pct_national.definition: where the county's score falls among all scored counties, using the mid-rank definition, so the median county reads fiftieth

pct_state.definition: the same position computed among the counties of the county's own state

peer_median.definition: the median score of the counties most similar to this one on population, density, education and the latest presidential margin; a similarity set for reading, not a matched control

enacted_restriction.definition: a moratorium, zoning restriction or ban recorded as passed, enacted, active, extended or expired; the label is historical and counts a restriction that later lapsed

tracked_case.definition: an opposition event recorded in this platform's tracker with its own source

outcome_grade.definition: the recorded outcome of a case on the platform's outcome ladder; unverified grades are outcomes not yet confirmed by a terminal source and are shown as recorded

notices.descriptive: These figures describe recorded histories and associations. They do not say what caused any decision, and they do not predict the outcome of a specific project.
notices.interval_first: Quote the interval with the score, never the score alone.
notices.unitemized: The enacted label rests on records that are not itemized here; the absence of a listed instrument is a coverage gap, not a contradiction.
